**EN**

PHP developer & GTA V mod creator from China.

Currently building **[ZERODREAM RACING](https://zdr.ac/)**, a FiveM multiplayer server focused on racing and drifting. Day job is **FiveM Lua** and **PHP**; I also pick up Java / Go / JavaScript / C# / Python when needed. Open to freelance work — if it’s PHP or FiveM, let’s talk.
